## Table {#edt5}

Download: [`ExtendedDataTable5_GP_AUC_tissue.xlsx`](https://github.com/AgueroZZ/immgenT-GP-analysis/raw/main/figures/final-selected/ExtendedDataTable5_GP_AUC_tissue.xlsx).

```{r edt5-preview, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DT))
source("../code/R/table_xlsx.R")
tab <- read_table_xlsx("../figures/final-selected/ExtendedDataTable5_GP_AUC_tissue.xlsx")
DT::datatable(
  tab,
  rownames = FALSE,
  filter = "top",
  options = list(
    pageLength = 10,
    lengthMenu = list(c(10, 25, 50, 100, -1), c("10", "25", "50", "100", "All")),
    scrollX = TRUE
  )
) |> DT::formatRound(columns = colnames(tab)[-1], digits = 3)
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Extended Data Table 5.** AUC score separating cells of each tissue from all
